verdict.rationale: The evidence points to a public GitHub repository for the product itself (github.com/Flagsmith/flagsmith), and the docs describe self-hosting the complete platform via Docker. That implies the source is publicly readable, but no evidence item names or confirms an open-source license, so the 'open license' part of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. a BSD/MIT/Apache statement), evidence that the full platform rather than only parts is under that license, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure
You can use Docker to set up an entire Flagsmith Feature Flag environment locally
